test_title: PYST 34 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: What will be the simple interest on a principal of Rs. 1600 for 8 years at the rate of 2 percent per annum?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage = **Rate** × **Time**

Total interest % = 2% × 8 = 16%

Simple Interest = 16% of **Principal**

SI = 16% of 1600 = 16 × 16 = 256

**∴ The correct answer is ₹256.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹1600

**Time (T)** = 8 years

**Rate (R)** = 2% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da5a14e8b772733b9dca6533092e2ae21cb0fc8ed54bfd15293aea6c93b9431f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (1600 × 2 × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (1600 × 16) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 16 × 16

⇒ SI = 256

**∴ The correct answer is ₹256.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

The total **Amount (A)** received after the time period is the sum of **Principal** and **Simple Interest**: A = P + SI.

Compound Interest (CI)

For **Compound Interest**, interest is calculated on the initial principal and also on the accumulated interest of previous periods: A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ.

SI vs CI for 1 Year

If the interest is compounded annually, the **Simple Interest** and **Compound Interest** for the first year are always equal.

Rate of Interest Calculation

The **Rate (R)** can be found if other variables are known using the formula: R = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T).
